svg.title: A solid with semicircle cross sections on the region under y = √x
svg.desc: In 3D, the base region under y = √x from x = 0 to 4 lies flat on the floor. Semicircles stand on it, each perpendicular to the x-axis with its diameter across the base, so a slice at x has diameter s = √x. One slice is highlighted in green. A side panel shows the semicircle with diameter s and radius s/2, its area ½ · π · (s/2)² = (π/8)s², and the volume, the integral from 0 to 4 of (π/8)(√x)² dx = π, about 3.14. Using s as the radius instead of s/2 makes the answer 4 times too big.
